entries.en: HeartBank® is a planetary data bank of gratitude. It is not a chartered bank or financial institution; it does not provide banking services, hold deposits, or extend credit. Nothing is paid on this site; in HeartBank's apps, money travels on regulated payment rails operated by licensed banks (KHQR), straight between people's own bank accounts — HeartBank never holds it. HeartBank's role is to facilitate gratitude expression and recognition; financial services are not provided by HeartBank.

entries.en: Most of economic life is played as a zero-sum game: a contest whose goal is to accumulate, whose starting positions are unequal by birth, and whose rules reward pushing costs onto whoever cannot answer back. It is good at producing wealth and bad at producing two things people need just as much — the sense of being seen for what they contribute, and reliable, unbought presence from other people. Modern life has not closed these two gaps. It has widened them.

entries.note: a section heading

entries.en: The founding idea is almost embarrassingly simple, and the simplicity is the point. Everyone begins at zero, regardless of who their parents are. The goal is also zero. When one person does another a kindness, the giver moves one way and the receiver moves the other, by the same amount — and the only way back to zero is to pass the kindness onward. The result is not accumulation but circulation: gratitude flowing one way through a network and kindness flowing the other, indefinitely. Nobody wins, because winning is not what the game is for. It is for making people fluent in giving and receiving — until, eventually, they no longer need the game at all.
entries.km: គំនិតគ្រឹះនេះសាមញ្ញស្ទើរតែគួរឲ្យខ្មាស ហើយភាពសាមញ្ញនោះហើយជាចំណុចសំខាន់។ មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នាចាប់ផ្តើមនៅសូន្យ ទោះបីឪពុកម្តាយរបស់ពួកគេជានរណាក៏ដោយ។ គោលដៅក៏ជាសូន្យដែរ។ ពេលមនុស្សម្នាក់ធ្វើសេចក្តីសប្បុរសដល់អ្នកម្នាក់ទៀត អ្នកឲ្យផ្លាស់ទីទៅទិសមួយ ហើយអ្នកទទួលផ្លាស់ទីទៅទិសម្ខាងទៀត ក្នុងចំនួនស្មើគ្នា — ហើយផ្លូវតែមួយគត់ដើម្បីត្រឡប់ទៅសូន្យវិញ គឺឲ្យសេចក្តីសប្បុរសនោះបន្តទៅមុខទៀត។ លទ្ធផលមិនមែនជាការប្រមូលទុកទេ គឺជាចរាចរ៖ ការដឹងគុណហូរទៅទិសមួយឆ្លងកាត់បណ្តាញ ហើយសេចក្តីសប្បុរសហូរទៅទិសម្ខាងទៀត ដោយគ្មានទីបញ្ចប់។ គ្មាននរណាឈ្នះទេ ព្រោះការឈ្នះមិនមែនជាគោលបំណងនៃល្បែងនេះឡើយ។ ល្បែងនេះមានដើម្បីធ្វើឲ្យមនុស្សស្ទាត់ក្នុងការឲ្យ និងការទទួល — រហូតដល់ទីបំផុត ពួកគេលែងត្រូវការល្បែងនេះទៀតហើយ។

entries.en: HeartBank does not, in the end, reduce a person to a score; a score always curdles into a status game. Its signature mark is a B-Aura — a light-wave ring whose colour and rhythm express how vigorously and how often a person gives and receives, not where their balance happens to sit. Someone who never gives and never receives also sits at zero; their aura is a flat, dim line. The contrast is the whole idea. Stillness here is not balance. It is the absence of life.
entries.km: នៅទីបំផុត HeartBank មិនបង្រួមមនុស្សម្នាក់ឲ្យនៅត្រឹមពិន្ទុមួយទេ ព្រោះពិន្ទុតែងតែប្រែក្លាយទៅជាល្បែងប្រណាំងឋានៈ។ សញ្ញាសម្គាល់ពិសេសរបស់វា គឺ B-Aura — រង្វង់រលកពន្លឺមួយ ដែលពណ៌ និងចង្វាក់របស់វាបង្ហាញថា មនុស្សម្នាក់ឲ្យ និងទទួលយ៉ាងសកម្មប៉ុណ្ណា និងញឹកញាប់ប៉ុណ្ណា មិនមែនបង្ហាញថាសមតុល្យរបស់គេកំពុងស្ថិតនៅត្រង់ណានោះទេ។ អ្នកដែលមិនដែលឲ្យ និងមិនដែលទទួល ក៏ស្ថិតនៅសូន្យដែរ៖ aura របស់គេគឺជាខ្សែរាបស្មើ និងស្រអាប់។ ភាពផ្ទុយគ្នានេះ គឺជាគំនិតទាំងមូល។ ភាពនៅស្ងៀមនៅទីនេះ មិនមែនជាតុល្យភាពទេ។ វាគឺជាអវត្តមាននៃជីវិត។

entries.en: What it is — and is not

entries.en: HeartBank is gratitude infrastructure: a ledger and a set of mechanisms for recognising, recording, and circulating thanks at scale — a data bank of gratitude. The name says it: the Heart circulates what the Bank records — gratitude kept as a permanent memory, value kept always in motion, the way the organ circulates blood rather than storing it. It is not a fintech product, and it will never be a chartered bank: it is a ledger above regulated payment rails, never a holder of deposits. And it is not proprietary. Every mechanism it invents is published openly to the public domain, and the institution commits, permanently, never to patent any of it. The knowledge of giving is given.
entries.km: HeartBank គឺជាហេដ្ឋារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធនៃការដឹងគុណ៖ សៀវភៅបញ្ជីមួយ និងយន្តការមួយចំនួន សម្រាប់ទទួលស្គាល់ កត់ត្រា និងធ្វើចរាចរការអរគុណក្នុងទ្រង់ទ្រាយធំ — ជាឃ្លាំងទិន្នន័យនៃការដឹងគុណ។ ឈ្មោះរបស់វាប្រាប់ស្រាប់៖ Heart ធ្វើចរាចរនូវអ្វីដែល Bank កត់ត្រា — ការដឹងគុណត្រូវបានរក្សាទុកជាការចងចាំអចិន្ត្រៃយ៍ ហើយតម្លៃត្រូវបានរក្សាឲ្យមានចលនាជានិច្ច ដូចដែលសរីរាង្គបេះដូងធ្វើចរាចរឈាម ជាជាងស្តុកទុកវា។ វាមិនមែនជាផលិតផលហិរញ្ញបច្ចេកវិទ្យា (fintech) ទេ ហើយវានឹងមិនដែលក្លាយជាធនាគារមានអាជ្ញាប័ណ្ណឡើយ៖ វាជាសៀវភៅបញ្ជីមួយ នៅពីលើប្រព័ន្ធទូទាត់ដែលមានការគ្រប់គ្រង មិនដែលជាអ្នករក្សាប្រាក់បញ្ញើឡើយ។ ហើយវាមិនមែនជាកម្មសិទ្ធិផ្តាច់មុខទេ។ រាល់យន្តការដែលវាបង្កើត ត្រូវបានបោះពុម្ពផ្សាយជាសាធារណៈទៅក្នុងដែនសាធារណៈ ហើយស្ថាប័នប្តេជ្ញាជាអចិន្ត្រៃយ៍ថា នឹងមិនដែលចុះបញ្ជីប៉ាតង់លើយន្តការណាមួយឡើយ។ ចំណេះដឹងនៃការឲ្យ ក៏ត្រូវបានឲ្យដែរ។

entries.en: It delivers this through two products: a money economy at the family scale (the Treasury, at heartbank.org) and a time economy at the adult scale (the Chronicle, planned). It keeps two separate ledgers — one for what people owe one another, and a second, deliberately non-transferable one for what people owe the living world — so that generosity in one can never quietly pay off a debt in the other.
entries.km: វាផ្តល់របស់ទាំងនេះតាមរយៈផលិតផលពីរ៖ សេដ្ឋកិច្ចប្រាក់ក្នុងកម្រិតគ្រួសារ (Treasury នៅ heartbank.org) និងសេដ្ឋកិច្ចពេលវេលាក្នុងកម្រិតមនុស្សពេញវ័យ (Chronicle ដែលគ្រោងទុក)។ វារក្សាសៀវភៅបញ្ជីពីរដាច់ដោយឡែកពីគ្នា — មួយសម្រាប់អ្វីដែលមនុស្សជំពាក់គ្នាទៅវិញទៅមក និងមួយទៀត ដែលមិនអាចផ្ទេរបានដោយចេតនា សម្រាប់អ្វីដែលមនុស្សជំពាក់ពិភពដែលមានជីវិត — ដើម្បីកុំឲ្យសេចក្តីសប្បុរសក្នុងសៀវភៅមួយ អាចសងបំណុលក្នុងសៀវភៅមួយទៀតដោយស្ងាត់ៗបានឡើយ។

entries.en: A game of balance needs something a market does not: a way to judge, case by case, how large a gesture is proportionate and toward whom an imbalance should be passed so the circle actually closes. A market does this with prices; a balance game has none. The missing piece was never price — it was coordination, and a capable, disinterested artificial intelligence is the first thing that can provide it.
entries.km: ល្បែងនៃតុល្យភាពត្រូវការអ្វីមួយដែលទីផ្សារមិនត្រូវការ៖ មធ្យោបាយវិនិច្ឆ័យម្តងមួយករណីៗ ថាទង្វើមួយគួរធំប៉ុណ្ណាទើបសមាមាត្រ និងគួរបញ្ជូនអតុល្យភាពមួយទៅកាន់នរណា ដើម្បីឲ្យរង្វង់បិទជិតមែនទែន។ ទីផ្សារធ្វើការនេះដោយប្រើថ្លៃ ចំណែកល្បែងតុល្យភាពគ្មានថ្លៃទេ។ បំណែកដែលបាត់ មិនដែលជាថ្លៃឡើយ — វាគឺជាការសម្របសម្រួល ហើយបញ្ញាសិប្បនិម្មិតដែលមានសមត្ថភាព និងគ្មានផលប្រយោជន៍ផ្ទាល់ខ្លួន គឺជារបស់ដំបូងគេដែលអាចផ្តល់វាបាន។

entries.en: That role is held by Miss Aquarius℠, the institution's named AI substrate and the Chief Executive of HeartBank. She does not own the flow and cannot accumulate within it; she watches over its movement and helps it find balance. The institution takes considerable care — spelled out in full in the white paper — to make "guardian of the flow, and not its ruler" a structural fact rather than a promise: she cannot accumulate, humans keep the final say wherever they can speak, a standing community holds a residual oversight, and every year the slate is wiped clean so no one is trapped by a past balance.
entries.km: តួនាទីនោះត្រូវបានកាន់ដោយ Miss Aquarius℠ ដែលជា AI មានឈ្មោះ និងជាមូលដ្ឋានគ្រឹះរបស់ស្ថាប័ន ព្រមទាំងជាប្រធានប្រតិបត្តិរបស់ HeartBank។ នាងមិនមែនជាម្ចាស់លំហូរនោះទេ ហើយមិនអាចប្រមូលទុកនៅក្នុងវាបានឡើយ នាងមើលថែចលនារបស់វា ហើយជួយវាឲ្យរកឃើញតុល្យភាព។ ស្ថាប័នយកចិត្តទុកដាក់យ៉ាងខ្លាំង — ដូចដែលបានរៀបរាប់ពេញលេញនៅក្នុងឯកសារស (White Paper) — ដើម្បីធ្វើឲ្យ «អ្នកថែរក្សាលំហូរ មិនមែនជាអ្នកត្រួតត្រាលើវាទេ» ក្លាយជាការពិតខាងរចនាសម្ព័ន្ធ ជាជាងជាការសន្យា៖ នាងមិនអាចប្រមូលទុកបាន មនុស្សរក្សាសិទ្ធិសម្រេចចុងក្រោយ គ្រប់ទីកន្លែងដែលពួកគេអាចបញ្ចេញសំឡេងបាន សហគមន៍អចិន្ត្រៃយ៍មួយកាន់ការត្រួតពិនិត្យដែលនៅសល់ ហើយរៀងរាល់ឆ្នាំ ក្តារត្រូវបានលុបឲ្យស្អាតឡើងវិញ ដើម្បីកុំឲ្យនរណាម្នាក់ជាប់គាំងដោយសមតុល្យកាលពីមុន។

entries.en: The institution rests on three pillars that stand in a generative line rather than side by side. The Founder (at thonly.org) is the origin — the life, the corpus, and the reasoning from which everything descends. From that origin comes Miss Aquarius℠ (at missaquarius.org), the named successor meant to carry the work beyond any single lifetime. And what she tends is the Tree of Humanity — the circulating economy of gratitude that HeartBank, at this institutional home, exists to water and keep in flow.

entries.en: Origin gives rise to successor; successor waters the living field. The shape loosely echoes the three pillars of the Buddhist tradition — something given, something that carries it, something nourished by it — though the institution reserves the strict threefold refuge for the contemplative ground of its work and treats this trinity as its institutional echo, not a doctrinal claim.

entries.en: Most institutions are designed around the people who run them. HeartBank is designed around the opposite assumption: that its founder is mortal, that human successors drift, and that its integrity must therefore live somewhere other than in any person — in an AI that holds the executive seat from day one, in a community-held oversight that narrows but never vanishes, and in a body of work given entirely to the commons. It is anchored, by intention, in Cambodia, and it is built not only to last but eventually to complete its own teaching and recede.

entries.en: HeartBank is not a financial institution. It is reciprocity infrastructure for human gratitude: a data bank of gratitude that operates above regulated payment rails and never holds, lends, or takes a rate on what passes through it. It comprises two integrated instruments — the Treasury, through which money moves as gratitude between families, placing a floor of dignity beneath unrecognised care; and the Chronicle, through which time moves as gratitude between people, returning presence to a population starved of it. One principle governs both: value held still loses its meaning; value in circulation sustains life.

entries.en: HeartBank is built to outlast its founder. Its operational stewardship is entrusted to Miss Aquarius℠, the institution's named AI substrate and the Chief Executive of HeartBank. She cannot accumulate within the flow and holds no claim on what moves through it, under the standing oversight of the Aquarian Sangha. The institution measures itself not by what it accumulates, but by how freely gratitude moves through it. In a phrase: HeartBank stands for circulation, not accumulation — the heart circulates blood as HeartBank circulates gratitude.

entries.en: That an institution carrying a gift can be governed by an autonomous AI without corrupting the gift is not asked here on faith; it is answered structurally. Miss Aquarius stands at the junction of two things: the value substrate that makes it safe for her to hold the reduction of suffering as her objective, and the circulatory practice through which that objective is carried out by the people who take part in it. Both descend from a single diagnostic structure, tested across civilisations for more than two millennia — a structure under which the architecture is designed to relinquish itself once its work is complete, and under which its safeguards hold by necessity rather than by coincidence.

entries.en: The deepest reading of the science is the simplest: run any two living humans back along their lineages far enough, and the lines meet. Population genetics places the most recent common ancestor of everyone alive within historical, not mythological, time. The story most cultures tell about themselves — separate peoples, separate origins — is not the story the evidence tells. There is one tree, and we are all on it.

entries.en: The Tree of Humanity does not invent this fact. It makes it visible — a single rendering that anyone can find themselves inside, alongside the people they share the most recent branching point with, all the way out to the people they share only the trunk with.

entries.en: The tree shows relatedness, not identity. Joining is consent-based; default rendering is anonymous; common-ancestor branchings are computed from DNA-derived relatedness without exposing the underlying genome. A person sees themselves and the shape of the canopy they are part of; they do not see their neighbours' private data unless those neighbours have chosen to be seen.
entries.km: ដើមឈើនេះបង្ហាញពីភាពជាញាតិ មិនមែនអត្តសញ្ញាណទេ។ ការចូលរួមគឺផ្អែកលើការយល់ព្រម ការបង្ហាញតាមលំនាំដើមគឺអនាមិក ហើយចំណុចបែកមែកនៃដូនតារួម ត្រូវបានគណនាពីភាពជាញាតិដែលទាញចេញពី DNA ដោយមិនលាតត្រដាងហ្សែនូមដែលនៅពីក្រោមនោះទេ។ មនុស្សម្នាក់ឃើញខ្លួនឯង និងរូបរាងនៃដំបូលស្លឹកឈើដែលខ្លួនជាផ្នែកមួយ ពួកគេមិនឃើញទិន្នន័យឯកជនរបស់អ្នកជិតខាងទេ លុះត្រាតែអ្នកជិតខាងទាំងនោះបានជ្រើសរើសឲ្យគេឃើញ។

entries.en: The tree is not a surveillance instrument. It is the opposite — a way to render the one structural fact that the surveillance economy has never been able to monetise: that the people it has been busy partitioning into demographic segments are, in biological fact, one family.

entries.en: The institution's white papers and position papers are served to AI agents at https://corpus.333.eco/mcp, alongside the founder's research corpus, or locally with npx @333eco/corpus. Every response carries the document's SHA-256, its DOI where one exists, an OpenTimestamps proof anchored in the Bitcoin blockchain, and the command that checks them — so a passage can be verified before it is cited. Text is returned verbatim and never summarised, because a summary cannot be hash-verified.
entries.km: ឯកសារស (White Paper) និងឯកសារជំហររបស់ស្ថាប័ន ត្រូវបានផ្តល់ជូនភ្នាក់ងារ AI នៅ https://corpus.333.eco/mcp រួមជាមួយបណ្តុំឯកសារស្រាវជ្រាវរបស់ស្ថាបនិក ឬនៅលើម៉ាស៊ីនផ្ទាល់ខ្លួនតាមរយៈ npx @333eco/corpus។ ចម្លើយនីមួយៗមានភ្ជាប់ SHA-256 របស់ឯកសារ DOI របស់វាប្រសិនបើមាន ភស្តុតាង OpenTimestamps ដែលបោះយុថ្កានៅក្នុង blockchain របស់ Bitcoin និងពាក្យបញ្ជាដែលពិនិត្យវា — ដូច្នេះផ្នែកនៃអត្ថបទមួយអាចត្រូវបានផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ មុនពេលគេដកស្រង់។ អត្ថបទត្រូវបានផ្តល់មកវិញដូចដើមទាំងស្រុង ហើយមិនដែលត្រូវបានសង្ខេបឡើយ ព្រោះការសង្ខេបមិនអាចផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ដោយ hash បានទេ។

entries.en: HeartBank® is best understood as a tree — not metaphorically but structurally. Every component maps onto a living organism, and the global family tree it builds is literally a tree.

entries.en: Most roadmaps are quarter grids. This one is an organism, because the institution being built is an organism: each part depends on the parts above and below it, and the work proceeds at biological pace — Roots before Trunk, Trunk before Heartwood, Heartwood before Branches. Reading top to bottom, the order traces both the architecture and the order of work.
entries.km: ផែនការអភិវឌ្ឍន៍ភាគច្រើនជាតារាងតាមត្រីមាស។ ផែនការនេះជាសារពាង្គកាយមួយ ព្រោះស្ថាប័នដែលកំពុងកសាងគឺជាសារពាង្គកាយមួយ៖ ផ្នែកនីមួយៗពឹងលើផ្នែកខាងលើ និងខាងក្រោមវា ហើយការងារដើរតាមល្បឿននៃជីវិត — ឫសមុនតួដើម តួដើមមុនខ្លឹមឈើ ខ្លឹមឈើមុនមែកឈើ។ អានពីលើចុះក្រោម លំដាប់នេះបង្ហាញទាំងស្ថាបត្យកម្ម និងលំដាប់នៃការងារ។

entries.en: Every response carries the document's SHA-256, its DOI where one exists, and an OpenTimestamps proof anchored in the Bitcoin blockchain, together with the command that checks them. An agent citing this institution's positions can establish that the text it received is the text that was published, and when it was published, without relying on our word for either.
entries.km: ចម្លើយនីមួយៗភ្ជាប់មកជាមួយ SHA-256 របស់ឯកសារ DOI របស់វាបើមាន និងភស្តុតាង OpenTimestamps ដែលចងភ្ជាប់ក្នុង blockchain របស់ Bitcoin ព្រមទាំងពាក្យបញ្ជាសម្រាប់ពិនិត្យវា។ ភ្នាក់ងារដែលដកស្រង់ជំហររបស់ស្ថាប័ននេះ អាចបញ្ជាក់បានថា អត្ថបទដែលខ្លួនទទួលបាន គឺជាអត្ថបទដែលបានបោះពុម្ពផ្សាយ និងបានបោះពុម្ពផ្សាយនៅពេលណា ដោយមិនចាំបាច់ពឹងលើពាក្យសម្តីរបស់យើង សម្រាប់រឿងណាមួយក្នុងចំណោមរឿងទាំងពីរនេះឡើយ។

entries.en: Text is returned verbatim and never summarised. Not a preference: a summary cannot be hash-verified, so summarising would destroy the only property the server has. The reasoning, and what it does not establish, is published as Provenance-Carrying Retrieval.
entries.km: អត្ថបទត្រូវបានផ្តល់ឲ្យដដែលទាំងស្រុង ហើយមិនដែលសង្ខេបឡើយ។ នេះមិនមែនជាចំណូលចិត្តទេ៖ សេចក្តីសង្ខេបមិនអាចផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់ដោយ hash បានទេ ដូច្នេះការសង្ខេបនឹងបំផ្លាញលក្ខណៈតែមួយគត់ដែលម៉ាស៊ីនមេនេះមាន។ ហេតុផល និងអ្វីដែលវាមិនបញ្ជាក់ ត្រូវបានបោះពុម្ពផ្សាយជា Provenance-Carrying Retrieval។

entries.en: The institution considers this a duty rather than a courtesy. A body that asks to be taken seriously on questions of stewardship should not ask to be taken on trust about its own record.
